title: Tutoring Incident Report Form
subtitle: An original operational incident report for tutoring that connects identity, evidence, authority, exceptions, privacy, and accountable closeout.
description: This Tutoring Incident Report Form supports the complete tutoring workflow from intake and routing through evidence, authorized decisions, exception ownership, qualified review, and final handoff.
use_case: Use the Tutoring Incident Report Form when the assigned tutoring coordinator needs one fillable record for learner goals, session routing, academic evidence, support, and release without inventing legal, medical, safety, consent, certification, or professional authority.

sections.title: Tutoring incident report identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this incident report to one learner goals, session routing, academic evidence, support, and release record, an accountable owner, and the current review route.

blocks.label: Tutoring record reference
blocks.guidance: Use the approved roster or case reference rather than creating a second identity.

blocks.label: Participant and responsible route
blocks.guidance: Record references and routing information only; keep sensitive details in approved systems.

blocks.label: Tutoring scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

fields.label: Scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

sections.title: Tutoring incident facts and immediate condition
sections.guidance: Record direct observations, reported information, exact times, and unknowns without blame or diagnosis.

blocks.label: Tutoring incident indicators
items: Learner did not arrive or left the assigned setting
Unauthorized pickup, contact, or virtual-session participant
Illness, injury, distress, or emergency response
Peer, conduct, boundary, or supervision concern
Technology, facility, transport, or access disruption
Private student record or personal information exposure
Approved support or accommodation could not be provided
Attendance, assignment, progress, or communication discrepancy

blocks.label: Event time, location, and information source
Chronological facts, exact words when necessary, source of each fact, unknowns, and observed impact

fields.label: Chronological facts, exact words, source, unknowns, and observed impact

blocks.label: Response and record boundary
blocks.guidance: This form records tutoring operations; it does not diagnose learning needs, change a school plan, promise academic outcomes, decide custody, or replace emergency services. Stop or escalate when identity, guardian or school direction, approved support, release, privacy, or safety is unresolved. Record objective learning evidence and route educational or professional decisions to authorized qualified reviewers.

sections.title: Tutoring people, property, records, and evidence
sections.guidance: Collect only information needed for response and follow-up; use approved restricted storage.

blocks.label: Property, system, document, or evidence references
Conflicting reports, missing records, unavailable evidence, privacy limits, and unresolved facts

fields.label: Conflicting reports, missing evidence, privacy limits, and unresolved facts

sections.title: Tutoring response, notification, and operating decision
sections.guidance: Document the action actually taken, why it was selected, who authorized it, and what remains unresolved.

blocks.label: Immediate actions and safeguards
items: Stopped or limited the affected tutoring activity, movement, or release
Protected the child, participant, volunteer, or affected person from further exposure
Used emergency services or the qualified response route when indicated
Reconciled identity, roster, headcount, item, or custody status
Notified the assigned tutoring coordinator and authorized guardian-facing route
Preserved objective facts and minimum-necessary evidence
Protected private records and restricted sensitive information
Established a temporary tutoring control and accountable follow-up owner

blocks.label: Tutoring incident operating decision
blocks.guidance: Record the authorized decision under current policy; this form does not grant authority to the preparer. Route uncertainty to the tutoring coordinator, guardian or school contact, and qualified support reviewer.

sections.title: Tutoring review, exception ownership, and corrective follow-up
sections.guidance: Preserve questions as questions and assign evidence, correction, and recipient follow-up.

blocks.label: Open question, action, owner, due point, and review
Reviewer observations, corrections to the initial record, limitations, and rationale for final disposition

fields.label: Reviewer observations, corrections, limitations, and disposition rationale

blocks.label: Incident exception and escalation indicators
items: Tutoring assignment or session cannot proceed as planned
Guardian, school, emergency contact, or release route is incomplete
Academic goal or requested service exceeds program authority
Approved accommodation, technology, or support is unavailable
Immediate illness, distress, missing-learner, or safety response is active
Attendance, progress, departure, or follow-up remains unresolved

sections.title: Tutoring outcome, closeout, and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and recipient visible.

blocks.label: Tutoring closeout controls
items: Session attendance and learning evidence accepted
Guardian or school communication status recorded
Unresolved academic or support action has an owner
Equipment and private student records returned
Schedule, technology, or program follow-up linked
Tutoring record stored with access and retention requirements
blocks.guidance: Check only completed controls; preserve unresolved work as an open action.

blocks.label: Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Remaining limitation, action, owner, due point, and recipient route
blocks.guidance: Keep unresolved work visible until an accountable recipient accepts it.

blocks.label: Unresolved work, child or participant impact, evidence location, and handoff message

fields.label: Unresolved work, impact, evidence location, and handoff message

blocks.label: Incident Report closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not legal consent, medical certification, or professional approval.
